_comment: Canonical King Intelligence config keys with safe CLIENT defaults. The migration step in /king-intelligence:update merges any ABSENT or BLANK key into the client's references/king-intelligence-config.md additively, and NEVER changes a value the client already set. Section + key order here is the order new keys/sections get written. The script paths are repo-relative (.claude/scripts/...): the migration COPIES the maintenance scripts there from the plugin and refreshes them on each update, so a skill that shells out (end-session) always resolves them with a plain path (a skill's shell call does not expand ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}).
